stories.title: INS Taragiri commissioned
stories.body: Rajnath Singh commissions the advanced stealth frigate at Visakhapatnam (Apr 3); a 6,670-tonne Project 17A warship built by Mazagon Dock with 75%+ indigenous content.

one_liners: INS Taragiri commissioned — Rajnath Singh commissions the advanced stealth frigate at Visakhapatnam (Apr 3)
